meta.title: Master QCS of a closed RFQ: "Create New Version" opens the "Are you sure you want to create a new version?" window

plan.title: Closed RFQ Master QCS version confirmation

steps.note: Open Master QCS for the prepared closed RFQ with Vendor A's bid.
Open the versioning confirmation without confirming it.

args.text: Are you sure you want to create a new version?

steps.note: Verify the expected confirmation message is shown.
Verify the dialog offers Create a New Version.
Verify no navigation or version creation occurred while the confirmation remains open.
